narrative.northStar: Practical guides in the Optimism identity
narrative.overview:
This is a scoped record of the implemented blog extension: `blog/index.html`, its two article pages, `assets/blog.css`, `assets/blog.js`, and the two SVG illustrations in `assets/blog/`, generated by `scripts/generate-blog.py`. It does not define or redesign the homepage. The description names the established direction; it introduces no new visual identity. Product context is in `docs/blog-product-context.md`; the specific editorial composition belongs in `docs/blog-surface-brief.txt` and the first-body-node `BLOG-READ-2026` comment.

The existing logo, Joanna type, navy and cyan anchor a light, readable editorial surface. Large regular-weight headings introduce practical material; muted summaries and small metadata support scanning. TexTerra informs editorial mechanics within this identity. Original diagrams explain the subjects without presenting invented measured results. This documentation records source behavior after the finish review; it does not claim fresh browser testing or user research.
keyCharacteristics: White reading ground, navy structure, blue interactive text and restrained cyan accents.
Regular Joanna headings, generous article leading and a bounded reading column.
Open editorial entries with rounded illustrations, rather than enclosed card panels.
Search and reading aids progressively enhance complete static articles.

rules.name: The Reading Ground Rule
rules.body: Keep the long-form reading column on white; use pale panels for bounded supporting material.

rules.name: The Quiet Heading Rule
rules.body: Keep Joanna headings regular and use size, whitespace and placement for hierarchy before adding weight.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate editorial content with spacing and rules; reserve the existing box-shadow for search focus.

dos: **Do** preserve the existing Optimism logo, Joanna family and navy/cyan identity within the blog.
**Do** keep the text column bounded and let illustrations and contents reflow at the observed breakpoints.
**Do** preserve visible focus, labeled controls, active states, reduced-motion behavior and the static reading path.
**Do** distinguish real editorial metadata from fictional examples inside instructional diagrams.
donts: **Don't** apply this scoped blog document as authority to redesign the homepage.
**Don't** turn the open story entries into raised panels or add decorative shadows to reading surfaces.
**Don't** treat the current two-entry arrangement, its topic counts or its specific copy as a permanent site-wide rule.
**Don't** promote SVG-specific Arial labels or illustration-only tints into a new global type or color system.
